name: Modal
description: Dialog overlay on a dark backdrop. Seven variants: confirm and alert (decision and acknowledgement), lightbox and video (media overlays), form (fields plus consent), detail (image plus a spec list) and wizard (a three-step choice dialog with progress). The element renders a trigger button where it sits in the page and portals the dialog to the end of <body>.
when_to_use: When an action or a piece of media needs the visitor's full attention without leaving the page — confirming a destructive step, enlarging an image, playing a video, or collecting a short form. Do not use it to hide primary page content: anything a visitor needs in order to understand the page belongs in the flow, not behind a click.
capabilities: seven variants: confirm | alert | lightbox | video | form | detail | wizard
renders an in-flow trigger button (solid | outline | ghost | link) that opens the dialog
focus is trapped while open, restored to the trigger on close
closes on Escape and on backdrop click; page scroll is locked while open
wizard tracks step progress and a choice per step
detail renders a definition list of spec label/value rows

variants.description: Question with a primary and secondary action. Default.
Warning icon plus a single acknowledge action.
Enlarged image with caption and counter.
Video player with poster, title, subline and duration.
Short form with fields and an optional consent checkbox.
Image beside a title, body and specification list.
Three-step dialog with a progress indicator and one choice per step.

breakpoints.mobile: Card fills the viewport width minus a small gutter; footer actions stack.
breakpoints.tablet: Card caps at the md width; detail and lightbox drop to a single column.
breakpoints.desktop: Card widths per variant: sm (confirm, alert), md (form, wizard), xl (lightbox, video, detail).

ai.prompt_summary: Modal: a dialog overlay opened by a trigger button rendered in the page. Element settings: variant (confirm|alert|lightbox|video|form|detail|wizard), trigger_label, trigger_variant (solid|outline|ghost|link), title, body, confirm_label, cancel_label, show_close. Media variants use image/caption/counter (lightbox), video_url/poster/duration/subline (video), image/subline/specs[] (detail). form uses fields[] (field_label, field_type) plus consent_label. wizard uses steps[] (step_title, step_description, choices[]).
ai.content_guidelines: Title at most 8 words and phrased as the decision the visitor is making. Body at most two sentences. Action labels are verbs, not 'OK' — 'Löschen', 'Termin buchen'. Always give cancel_label a value on the confirm variant; a confirmation with only one action is not a confirmation.

field_hints.trigger_label: What the visitor clicks in the page. Required — without it the dialog can never be opened.
field_hints.cancel_label: Leave empty ONLY on alert, where acknowledgement is the single action.
field_hints.specs: Short label/value pairs, e.g. 'Fläche' / '120 m²'. Rendered as a definition list.
field_hints.steps: Exactly three for the wizard; the progress indicator is drawn from the count.
